winter_Mon4.english: @, did you walk all the way here through this snow? I'm honored!

winter_Sat.japanese: 外へ出るには 寒すぎるから、 最近 室内で 少し運動を してるんだ。#$e#家の中が じめじめしていたら すまない。$s
winter_Sat.english: It's too cold to go outside, so lately I've been doing a little exercise indoors. Sorry if it's damp in the house.

winter_Sun.japanese: 今日は 床を 磨かないと。藻が 生えてきてる気が するから。$s#$e#手伝ってくれる 余裕は あるかい？
winter_Sun.english: I have to scrub the floor today. I feel like algae is starting to grow. Do you have time to help me?

winter_Thu.japanese: 息を深く吸ってみて。わかるかい？それが海の香りさ。#$e#吸った後の気分はどう？
winter_Thu.english: Try breathing deeply. Can you tell? That's the scent of the sea. How do you feel after breathing it in?

winter_Thu6.japanese: 息を深く吸ってみて。わかるかい？それが海の香りさ。#$e#僕はそれを嗅ぐたびに、子どもの頃を思い出すんだ。あの頃は、海が素晴らしく思えたよ。
winter_Thu6.english: Try breathing deeply. Can you tell? That's the scent of the sea. Every time I smell it, I remember my childhood. Back then, the sea seemed wonderful.

winter_Tue.japanese: 人々は 何千年もの間、 海の恵みを得て 生きてきたんだ。#$e#僕はただ 食料品店へ 行くけど。$s
winter_Tue.english: People have lived on the sea's bounty for thousands of years. I just go to the grocery store, though.

winter_Tue10.japanese: @、君が そろそろ来るんじゃないかと 思ってたんだ。#$e#たぶん、 僕達は 見えない縁で 結ばれてるんじゃないかな。$l
winter_Tue10.english: @, I was thinking you'd come by soon. Maybe we're bound by an invisible tie.

wonIceFishing.japanese: おや、町一番の穴釣り名人じゃないか！本当に見事な腕前だったよ。$h#$e#私に勝ち目はないが、いつもスポーツの一環として参加しているんだ。
wonIceFishing.english: Oh, if it isn't the town's best ice-fishing master! That was truly splendid skill. I don't stand a chance, but I always take part in the spirit of sport.
